newsitem.title: UK: Ultra wins 48 mln stg Nimrod contract.
newsitem.headline: Ultra wins 48 mln stg Nimrod contract.

text.p: Ultra Electronics Holdings Plc said on Monday that it has been awarded an initial 48 million stg contract to supply acoustic systems for the British Aerospace Plc Nimrod 2000 next generation Maritime Patrol Aircraft for the Royal Air Force.
The defence and aerospace manufacturer said it would supply systems to the Boeing Defense and Space Group which is supplying portions of the mission system under a subcontract to British Aerospace.
"This is a significant contract for Ultra which consolidates our capability in airborne acoustic systems for submarine detection," said Julian Blogh, chief executive of Ultra, in a statement.
